question: Dribbling skills are NOT used in which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dribbling skills are crucial in **Basketball**, **Hockey**, and **Football** as they involve controlling the ball/puck while moving.
 
• In **Basketball**, dribbling involves bouncing the ball continuously while walking or running.
 
• In **Hockey**, dribbling refers to maneuvering the puck with the stick while maintaining control during play.
 
• In **Football**, dribbling means skillfully controlling and moving the ball with the feet to evade opponents.
 
• **Chess** does not involve any physical dribbling skills as it is a board game focused on strategic moves of pieces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basketball** was invented by Dr. James Naismith in 1891 and is a popular team sport played worldwide.
 
• **Hockey** has different forms like ice hockey and field hockey, each with unique dribbling techniques suitable for the surface.
 
• **Football**, also known as soccer, is the world's most popular sport, with dribbling being a fundamental skill for players.
 
• **Chess** is a two-player strategy board game that originated in India around the 6th century AD.
 
• While physical sports require dribbling skills, **Chess** challenges the mind with strategic planning and foresight.
